svg.title: DVYDRM Circuit Cloud — 2X Infinite Board Zoom Master
svg.desc: 2X extended vector-only PCB: original Cinema 2.0 Pass 3 preserved exactly within x=0..1920,y=0..1080, new layered circuit architecture outside, seamless connection to original traces, reactivity group selectors and IDs.
svg.metadata: Center logo geometry is copied exactly from DVYDRM_Logo_Clean_Master_Download(4).svg and transformed uniformly. All circles are native SVG circles; chip bodies and pins are native rect/circle geometry.

Pass 3 runtime-ready SVG. Exact cloud path data remains unchanged from the approved Pass 2 master. Circuit cores use pathLength=1 for normalized dash/chase animation. Use companion Reactivity Map JSON for selectors, signals, impulses, and safe parameter ranges.

Original Pass3 preserved at x=0..1920,y=0..1080. Wide viewBox=-960 -540 3840 2160. When zoomed to original scale, use viewBox=0 0 1920 1080. Animate viewBox to -960 -540 3840 2160 or scale the SVG in Cinema 2.0. Outer live paths EXT_CIRCUIT_CORES > [data-reactive=true], big components EXT_MODULES > [data-reactive=true], terminal arrays EXT_TERMINAL_SYSTEM > [data-reactive=true]. No raster images embedded.
